title: Portraitist’s Dilemma
content: A cartoon of John Singer Sargent from 1917."Here's Sargent doing the Duchess XIn pink velours and pea-green checks.'It helps,' says he, 'to lift your GraceA bit above the commonplace.'"From "Confessions of a Caricaturist," by Oliver Herford.Available for download from Google Books.
